label: Add the channel of the invites log
summary: Adds column "invites" to "GuildLogs" when it does not have it

execute.description: add the nullable column, so the guilds that are there have no channel for it
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."GuildLogs" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "invites" int8

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'GuildLogs' AND column_name = 'invites') AS "result"
